title: Boot-state lookup over retained runtime history

effect.user: Daemon chooses the same boot observation cadence without scanning stopped runtime history.
assertions: Any booting row returns true, including an older generation.
Current state, outer rollback and reopen remain visible.
exclusions: Whole-daemon ticks, provider startup, CPU, latency, memory and physical I/O

idle.why: No booting rows is the primary history scan case.

first-use.why: Capture real method SQL and assert its Node query plan.

repeated.why: Three alternating control/current pairs per fixture.

background.why: No daemon or runtime is launched.

release.why: Fixture stores close; retention is not measured.

recovery.why: Separate lifecycle test covers rollback and file reopen.

fixture.seed: Real CoreStore schema; stopped history plus no/first/last boot among live rows.

recipe.readiness: Closed disposable real-schema database; exact SQL captured from current CoreStore method.
recipe.completion: Control and current SQL results and statement counters, with Node plan and method parity.
recipe.warmup: None; deterministic SQL work counters only.
recipe.teardown: Close stores and delete owned fixtures.

metrics.scope: sqlite3 CLI fullscan-step growth when stopped generations are added at fixed live population
metrics.collector: CLI .stats on; exact current CoreStore SQL; separately assert Node SQLite partial-index plan
metrics.invariant: Zero added fullscan steps from stopped history in every scenario/round.
metrics.noise: Engine-specific counters; no timing or Node instruction-count claim.

metrics.scope: sqlite3 CLI current minus full-table control VM steps with no stopped history
metrics.invariant: Additional VM instructions per query are at most 3*live+50 in all-live controls.

gaps: CLI counter engine differs from Node SQLite; the Node plan and behavior are checked separately.
Live-row traversal remains linear; no state index is added.
Whole-daemon 25ms cadence and stuck-boot exposure are unmeasured.
readiness: 150 paired count samples have boolean parity and zero stopped-history scan growth; all-live VM overhead is 5–125 instructions. Node plan/lifecycle controls pass separately. No timing claim.
